# Sakai Authentication Portal

> Secure authentication, identity management, and authorization gateway for the Sakai enterprise micro-frontend platform.

## Authentication Routes
- [Sign In](http://localhost:4002/login): User authentication and credential verification.
- [Sign Up](http://localhost:4002/auth/register): New account creation and onboarding.
- [Access Denied](http://localhost:4002/auth/access): Access control and permission fallback.
- [Error](http://localhost:4002/auth/error): Authentication error and session troubleshooting.

## Companion Applications
- [Dashboard](http://localhost:4000/): Administrative management, metrics, and business analytics.
- [Landing Page](http://localhost:4001/): Public portal, product features, and subscription plans.
